# Swagger UI assets

These unmodified files come from [Swagger UI v5.33.1](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui/tree/v5.33.1/dist).
The application serves them locally so interactive documentation works offline.
The external schema validator is disabled.

`LICENSE` is the upstream Apache 2.0 license. `swagger-ui-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`
contains notices for bundled dependencies. Keep both when updating the assets.
